'''Duelmania DownUnder 2020''' is the second installment of the Australian heavy Duelmania edition. 

A new, wider map pool was implemented in order to keep everyone happy. In addition to the classic {{abbr|TB5|The Big Five}}, along [[spinev2]] and [[bravado]] - 2 extremely established non-rail duel maps was added: [[Lostworld]] and [[Phrantic]]. Lost World being converted from Quake 3 Arena and Quake Live, while Phrantic coming from both CPMA and Quake 4. A total of 21 players signed up.

===Format===
* Double Elimination Bracket
* No division or groups
* One round per week in UB, 2 rounds in LB
